## AG Horizon 3.1.3-beta.2 (Test channel)

### TV
- **The remote works as soon as a form opens:** the keyboard no longer pops up by itself and takes the arrows; press OK on a field to type.
- **Updating:** the focus stays on the update banner from "Download update" to "Install".
- No update banner while Settings is open: Settings shows the update itself.

## AG Horizon 3.1.3-beta.1 (Test channel)

### TV
- **Moving down from the end of a long row** goes to the next row instead of skipping it (on some screen widths; fully fixed in beta.4).
- **Adding or editing a playlist:** up and down go through every field in order: Password, the Advanced toggle, Test connection and Save were skipped.
- **Cast & crew:** the row can be moved along with the remote, so it scrolls to everyone.

### Movie and series pages
- The blurred picture behind the details no longer shows as a band below the cast.
- **Sharper posters:** the poster comes from TMDB where it has one, and from the provider otherwise.

### Computer
- **Player controls** stay while the pointer rests on them (on a portrait screen they faded under the pointer), and can't be clicked while hidden.
